exchanges: hey, finally home, today was long
Welcome back, sounds like you've earned a quiet evening.
first week at harrowfield done and the horses already like me more than the people do lol
Ha, horses are good judges of character, congrats on getting through week one.
my sister wren is coming over sat with the new puppy so i gotta hide my shoes
Smart move, puppies love a good shoe.
wren finally picked a name for him, its turnip, i cant even
That's an adorable choice for a little pup.
rained the whole way home, im soaked
Hope you've got something warm to change into.
physio says its tendonitis in my wrist from all the hammering
Ouch, that sounds sore, I hope some rest helps it settle.
my sister-in-law maeve brought her whippet to dinner and it ate a napkin off the table
Bold dog, at least it was only a napkin.
kinda want takeout but also trying to save money
A cheap homemade dinner could scratch the same itch.
dara dragged me to pannikin again, she is obsessed with their scones
Sounds like she's found her happy place.
work was chill today, mostly cleaning tack
A calm day like that is underrated.
my buddy olu is moving out to lunenburg, gonna miss that guy
That's a big change, and you'll have a great excuse to visit.
watched the sunset from the porch, felt good
Little moments like that are the best.
honestly the ferry ride every morning is the best part of my day
Starting the day out on the water sounds lovely.
cant decide if i should repaint the bathroom
A fresh colour can make a small room feel new.
my sister says her basenji yodels instead of barking which is hilarious
That must make for some very musical mornings.
so tired, might just go to bed early
Early nights are a good reset.
my neighbours ancient saab wouldnt start again so i gave him a boost
Nice of you to help him get going.
made soup from scratch for once, pretty proud
Homemade soup is a win, well done.
picked up the mandolin again after like years, my fingers hate me
The calluses will come back faster than you think.
anyone else feel like this week lasted a month
It definitely happens, hang in there.
dad keeps going on about ballycastle like its paradise, he grew up there
Sounds like it left him with a lot of happy memories.
going to try sleeping in tomorrow, no alarms
Enjoy the lie-in, you deserve it.
reading piranesi before bed and its so strange in a good way
That one really sticks with people, enjoy it.
ok gonna make tea and wind down
Sounds perfect, have a cozy night.

remind me which place hired me
